title: Persona — World List — payload
description: List the holder's worlds, with their membership. Cursor-paginated like every other persona listing.

limit.description: The page size to ask for — never a cap on the result. A consumer that wants every world follows `nextCursor` to the end; one that treats this as a limit will silently draw a partial picture.

cursor.description: Continue a prior listing. Opaque: a producer echoes what it was given and MUST NOT construct one.

nextCursor.description: Present when more worlds remain. **Its absence is the only signal that a listing is complete** — a consumer MUST NOT infer exhaustion from a short page, because a maintainer may return fewer than `limit` for reasons of its own.

World.title: World
World.description: One named part of the holder's life, and what belongs to it. Agent-scoped, like the attribute pool and the profiles it groups — a world names records that sit above every trust context, so it cannot itself live inside one.

faceIds.description: Profiles belonging to this world. A maintainer MUST NOT prune an id whose profile has been deleted: a dangling member is how a consumer can offer to tidy, and silently dropping it turns a deletion the holder may not have intended into one they cannot see.

attributeIds.description: Attributes belonging to this world, with the same rule about dangling ids as `faceIds`.
